comments.body: get this from the 'armour' chest at the coliseum, cant remember how many roman coins it needs but around 2500. the chests at the coliseum change every monday. Also there is a helmet, gloves and greaves chest. if you collect the Lorica Hamata(body armour), Corinthian helmet, Legate greaves, legate gloves you will have earned yourself the 'Gladiator' title. Reward is the Lanista Gladius sword, 78att, +2 SP +1 merchandise knowledge. There is also a weapons chest that drops the 'Dussack' needs gladiator title, 83 att, 15 def, +2 SP +2 SM +1 plunder, my fave weapon atm :)
